title: The log on disk
dek: A partition is a directory of segment files holding batches exactly as the producer sent them. This first part of a five-part teardown reads Apache Kafka 4.4.0 down to the byte: the 61-byte batch header and what its CRC leaves out, an append that fsyncs nothing by default, two sparse indexes nobody checksums, rolls and retention driven by record timestamps, a tombstone with two clocks, and what recovery does to hand-injected damage, from one lost batch to a broker that will not start.
byline: 6 November 2026 · Subject: kafka@1156b275 (Apache Kafka 4.4.0) · Part 1 of 5 · Read from the source; measured where this machine allows
description: Apache Kafka 4.4.0 taken apart, part 1: the partition directory, the record batch byte by byte, an append that does not sync, sparse offset and time indexes, record-time rolls and retention, compaction and tombstones, and log recovery under hand-injected damage.
og_description: Part 1 of a five-part Kafka teardown at kafka 1156b275 (4.4.0): real bytes of a 94-byte batch, a CRC that excludes the fields the broker stamps, one fsync across a 12 s acks=all run, indexes believed on open, retention that runs on record timestamps, a tombstone's two clocks, and hand-injected damage that ranges from one lost batch to a broker that will not start.
twitter_description: Apache Kafka 4.4.0 taken apart, part 1: the log on disk, byte by byte, with real dumps and hand-injected damage labelled as such.
badges_callout:
How to read the badges

from the code marks a fact read from the pinned source, cited as repo/path:line: Apache Kafka 4.4.0 (1156b275). Paths are relative to the kafka/ checkout; storage/…/log/ abbreviates storage/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/storage/internals/log/, and a bare file name is under one of the trees named nearby. measured here marks bytes or counts observed on the research box: one broker on loopback, on a shared 2-vCPU machine with one disk. Timings there show relative behaviour, never capacity. Most runs are single runs, and they are called that. Tail cuts and flipped bits are simulated damage, done by hand with the broker dead; no real power cut was run. reconstruction marks a judgement drawn from those sources rather than read in one place.

This is Part 1 of 5 of Kafka, taken apart. Part 2 follows one request on the wire and through the broker; Part 3 covers what an ack promises, replication and the metadata quorum; Part 4 covers producers and consumer groups; Part 5 covers exactly-once, and ends with the findings register.
